notes.title: 7/15/23 - Anchored Traps Update
notes.content:
This update reworks traps in a major way! You now affix traps to each other at anchor points rather than just dropping them on to one another. This opens up lots of exciting new possibilities for multi-trap structures and I'm excited to see what people do with it! 

Additionally, 4 new traps have been added which take advantage of the new system to do some pretty nifty things! The pulley moves a suspended trap between two points. The hanger can support two traps at once, keeping them out of the way of small enemies. The swinger spins an affixed trap in a circle, much like the flail trap. Last but not least, the Minecart Launcher fires off a cart which bashes into enemies. The first trap that affixed on top of the launcher will also be fired off with the minecart, careening into your foes!

I hope they are fun, if you have any feedback or find a bug you can talk about it on the community Discord: https://discord.gg/9phseyUnrQ
